create_kodak_dataset: create a Kodak dataset instance from a root directory with optional hash checking
download_kodak_images: download the 24 Kodak images from the default URL into a specified root directory
load_kodak_image_by_index: load a Kodak image by index using the dataset getitem method with optional transforms
check_kodak_integrity: check the SHA1 hash integrity of downloaded Kodak images to detect corruption
iterate_kodak_dataset: iterate over the Kodak dataset to load and transform all 24 images for training
